instruction: The precondition file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open that file; it contains the base part shown in the before image and sketch(es) you will need. Build the target shape shown in the after image by adding the pad and pocket operations from the supplied sketches. Use Sketch002 to create the first Pad with a 90 mm length. Use Sketch003 to create the Pocket with a 90 mm depth, cutting in the reversed direction. Use Sketch004 to create the next Pad with a 20 mm length. Use Sketch005 to create the final Pad with a 90 mm length. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
